description: Image compression before upload and Cloudinary URL transformation helpers for optimized delivery
steps: Create src/lib/imageCompression.ts - client-side image compression using Canvas API: function compressImage(file: File, options?: { maxWidth?: number; quality?: number }): Promise<Blob>. Default maxWidth=1080, quality=0.8. Creates an offscreen canvas, draws the image scaled down, exports as JPEG blob. Skip compression for files already under 100KB or non-image types.

Update src/lib/cloudinary.ts - add URL transformation helpers: getOptimizedUrl(url: string, options?: { width?: number; quality?: string; format?: string }): string. This should parse the Cloudinary URL and insert transformation parameters (w_, q_, f_auto). Add preset functions: getThumbnailUrl(url, size=150), getFeedImageUrl(url, width=1080), getProfileAvatarUrl(url, size=200).
Update src/components/social/PostCard.tsx - use getFeedImageUrl() for post images instead of raw media_url. Use getProfileAvatarUrl() for avatar images.
Update src/pages/Feed.tsx, src/pages/Discover.tsx - use getProfileAvatarUrl() for avatar images in these pages
Update the uploadToCloudinary function in src/lib/cloudinary.ts to compress images before upload by calling compressImage() on image files
acceptance_criteria: compressImage function resizes images to max 1080px width and compresses to 80% JPEG quality
getOptimizedUrl correctly transforms Cloudinary URLs with width/quality/format params
PostCard uses optimized URLs for images
Images are compressed before upload to Cloudinary
